description: Fork of overseerr for Jellyfin support

promotion.reason: Withheld on 2026-09-10 although it qualified. The definition pins 2.7.3, whose image was last built 2025-08-14; upstream is on 3.4.1, released 2026-07-30. Offering a 13-month-old image a whole major version behind would hand somebody a copy that cannot be updated from inside the app. Revisit when the definition moves to 3.x.

risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.
Manages requests for a Jellyfin, Emby or Plex server you already run. On its own it opens to a setup wizard that asks for that server's address, and does nothing useful until you have one.
